call-analysis-fb3f926d-6a9e-4afc-bd7a-17.summary: The caller pretends to be from Mumbai Cyber Cell and threatens a 'digital arrest' unless a ₹25,000 UPI payment is made. This is a classic voice phishing scam using police impersonation and financial coercion.
